t: That the Government and people of the United States unite with the city of Reading, Pennsylvania, in a fitting and appropriate observance of the two-hundredth anniversary of its founding.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that 'unite with the city of Reading' is coordination with a local government. But this is a ceremonial declaration of joint commemoration. It sets up no consultation, hearing, advisory body, comment process, or right to sue tied to any federal decision, so no outside party is brought into federal decision-making.
fable.s: unite with the city of Reading, Pennsylvania, in a fitting and appropriate observance of the two-hundredth anniversary of its founding

qwen_block.w: This section is a ceremonial resolution expressing a desire for unity in observance of an anniversary. It does not establish any formal process for consultation, coordination, or decision-making involving outside parties. There is no requirement for public comment, hearings, advisory boards, or legal rights to sue; it is merely a statement of intent for a symbolic event.

Reading is a local government outside the federal government, but "unite with" here means celebrating together, not taking part in federal decisionmaking.
